title.narrative: Strengthening HMIS, Laboratory System and Procurement & Supply Chain Management Systems and enhancing State Engagement in Nigeria - Nigeria (01-Apr-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Nigeria, RSSH, National Agency for the Control of AIDS (NACA)This program has the following goals: RSSH: Strengthen the procurement and supply chain management system for efficient health service delivery. RSSH: Strengthen the National Health Management Informaton System (NHMIS). RSSH: Ensure equitable, safe, appropriate, quality, and effective laboratory services to meet current and future needs. RSSH: Promote community engagement for sustainable health development. RSSH: Ensure equitable, safe, appropriate, quality, and effective medical and laboratory services to meet current and future needs. RSSH: Provide effective leadership and an enabling policy environment that ensures adequate oversight and accountability for the delivery of quality health care for sustainable development of the national health system. The objectives of this program are: PSA plant deployment and ensuring functionality. PHC revitalization and support to enhance access to health services. Enhance M&E system and specifically e-reporting. Lab system strengthening - including genomic sequencing and lab upgrade. Expand quality improvement through integrated supervision and targeted support at PHC level
